entities.name: Bifunctional IspD/IspF
observations: 396-aa query aligns to reviewed bacterial IspD/IspF proteins; best hit Q6ADI0 has 64.6% identity and 97.0% query coverage (homology-based assignment).
Predicted to catalyze two steps of the MEP isoprenoid-biosynthesis pathway; annotated references require a divalent metal cation.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: The reference enzyme is annotated for MEP pathway steps 2 and 4 of IPP biosynthesis from 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate.
